name: Feed Your Teto
desc:
🥖 Welcome to Feed Your Teto! 🥖

Kasane Teto is here, and she is VERY hungry! In this fun and addictive incremental simulator, your goal is simple: feed Teto as many snacks as possible and watch her literally GROW to massive proportions!

[UPD] The latest update probably contains several bugs or unrealistic statistics. Please leave feedback in my group.

🎮 HOW TO PLAY:
👆 CLICK Teto to feed her snacks and earn money!
🏭 BUILD your own snack farm to automate your food production!
📈 UPGRADE your buildings, workers, and click power to get rich faster!
🔄 REBIRTH to earn powerful permanent multipliers and become unstoppable!
🌍 EXPAND your territory as Teto reaches new levels of happiness!

✨ FEATURES:

Unlock Utaus and Vocaloids to help deliver food!

Watch Teto get bigger and bigger as you progress!

💖 Do you have what it takes to satisfy Teto's infinite hunger?
👍 Don't forget to LIKE and FAVORITE the game to support future updates!

🔖 Tags: Tycoon, Simulator, Clicker, Incremental
